title: WaterBench - a list of water modelling reference datasets
text:
The DHI WaterBench datasets are aimed at supporting educational, research, and exploratory activities, such as:

Experimenting with water modeling using MIKE Powered by DHI.
Validating hydrodynamic model outputs with observational data.
Developing methods for automatically calibrating model parameters.
Building data-driven models, including machine learning surrogates of the MIKE simulation results.









DHI. (2024). Hydrodynamic model of Øresund: MIKE21 model setup, outputs and observation data (1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14160710







DHI. (2024). Hydrodynamic model of Conception Bay: MIKE21 model setup, outputs and observation data (1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14504931
